name: State of Qatar

areaKm2.note: asOf 2024. Surface area 11,637 km2 (AG.SRF.TOTL.K2); low is land area 11,490 km2 (AG.LND.TOTL.K2).

population.note: asOf 2025 (World Bank SP.POP.TOTL 2,972,215). Low -1% / high +1.5% for 2026 growth and estimate uncertainty. All residents; ~88-90% foreign nationals.

activePersonnel.note: IISS Military Balance 2025 p.364 as quoted: 16,500 active (CIA Factbook 2025 ~15,000). High allows for national-service conscripts in training. Paramilitary 5,000 excluded.

trainedReserves.note: IISS Military Balance 2025: no reserves listed. High is an educated allowance for men who completed national service (since 2014).

supportPersonnel.note: Active 16,500 minus infantry P roles (7,000). Covers air force, navy, air defence, crews and logistics (many contract foreigners).

mobilizationRatio.note: Qatari citizens are only ~10-12% of ~3 million residents; 3-12% of citizens mobilised (Gulf analogue) gives ~0.4-1.5% of total residents.

gdpPerCapita.note: asOf 2025. GDP 262,041,248,341 2011 int$ (World Bank NY.GDP.MKTP.PP.KD rebased x 0.8005) / population 2,972,215 = 88,164 2011 int$. Range +/-10%. Corrected 2026-10-29: values x1.0376 because the rebase factor was an arithmetic error (0.8005); the right factor is 0.8306 (FRED GDPDEF, 2017=100: 2011 91.478 / 2021 110.130). Figures quoted above are before the correction.

gdp.note: asOf 2025. World Bank NY.GDP.MKTP.PP.KD (constant 2021 int$) 327,346,968,571 x 0.8005 (US GDP deflator 2011/2021) = 262,041,248,341 2011 int$. Range +/-10% for PPP benchmark uncertainty and the relative-price drift the rebase ignores. Corrected 2026-10-29: values x1.0376 because the rebase factor was an arithmetic error (0.8005); the right factor is 0.8306 (FRED GDPDEF, 2017=100: 2011 91.478 / 2021 110.130). Figures quoted above are before the correction.

milSpendShare.note: SIPRI via World Bank: 6.5% of GDP (2022, last published value). Range 4-8% (educated) because the series is stale and wartime 2026 spending unknown.

industrialShare.note: asOf 2025: industry incl. construction (and hydrocarbons) 57.0% of GDP (NV.IND.TOTL.ZS). Range +/-7% for oil-price swings.

foodSurplus.note: Educated guess. Imports ~90% of food despite post-2017 dairy self-sufficiency push.

annualCohort.note: asOf 2025. Males reaching military age per year = male population 2,112,996 x share of males aged 15-19 3.179% (SP.POP.1519.MA.5Y) / 5 = 13,433. Male population from SP.POP.TOTL.MA.IN. Males only (conscript-pool convention). Range +/-10% for single-year cohort variation. Includes expatriate youths; Qatari males are ~15% of the cohort.

roadKm.note: asOf 2016: 7,039 km. High allows for the World Cup era expansion.

railKm.note: CIA Factbook lists no railways. Doha Metro (~76 km, urban passenger) and Lusail tram excluded; high includes the metro.

majorPorts.note: CIA Factbook 2024: 6 ports, 0 large, 1 medium (Hamad); key ports also Ras Laffan, Mesaieed, Doha.

merchantTonnage.note: asOf 2025: not in the list of flags over 1,000,000 GT, so under ~1.6 million DWT; mid is an educated guess. Nakilat's LNG fleet is largely foreign-flagged.

supplyRangeKm.note: Educated guess. Small country; C-17 airlift.

draftAnimals.note: Educated guess. Camels; not from FAO data.

nuclearWarheads.note: Qatar is not listed among the nine nuclear-armed states in the FAS Status of World Nuclear Forces 2026 table.

homeDefense.note: Rubric 1.0-1.1: flat peninsula with no depth; local supply only.

notes: WARTIME snapshot: struck by Iran (Al Udeid, June 2025; Ras Laffan, 2026) and shot down two Iranian Su-24s in the 2026 Iran war (war article). asOf 2025 economic data, 2026 order of battle. Population: all residents inside ne:QAT, ~90% expatriates; the mobilization ratio is set very low for that reason. Money in 2011 int$ via derived:ppp-rebase-2011. Counts from QEAF, Qatar Armed Forces and Navy articles; land-vehicle and air-defence counts are educated guesses (grade D). No ships_major (corvettes only). Turkish troops at Tariq bin Ziyad base and US forces at Al Udeid are foreign forces and not counted.
